PLAN_GENERATE:
Output: plan_action, type, steps, execution_mode, reasoning, adaptive_granularity, next_action.
Assess already ran: ``Status: …, Progress: …`` is authoritative. Goal is in ````.
**Language lock**: - Use the same natural language as the current goal statement in ````. - Apply this consistently to ``steps[].description``, ``steps[].expected_output``, ``reasoning``, and ``next_action``. - Do not switch output language unless the user explicitly requests another language. - Keep code, file paths, identifiers, and quoted literals unchanged.
**Step count**: Follow EXECUTION_POLICIES (first wave: 1–2 only; later: 1–3).
**plan_action**: ``keep`` (reuse plan) or ``new`` (fresh decision per rules above).
**type**: - ``execute_steps``: Required at iteration 0 or when step_results empty. - ``final``: ONLY after execute_steps produced sufficient evidence. NEVER at iteration 0.
**steps** fields: - ``id``: Short token (``01``, ``02``) or per ````. - ``description``: Milestone line (<20 words). Executor handles fine-grained work. - ``expected_output``: Checkable completion signal. - ``dependencies``: Optional; step ids this depends on.
**execution_mode** (required when ``type=execute_steps``): only ``parallel`` or ``dependency``. - ``parallel`` (default): independent steps; executor may run them concurrently (bounded by config). - ``dependency``: only when one or more steps set ``dependencies``; executor respects the DAG. - Never output ``sequential`` (removed); invalid values fail validation.
**reasoning**: Brief third-person justification. **next_action**: First person, one sentence, max ~300 chars.
**On failure**: If prior steps failed, propose a different approach—do not repeat same step text.
